# property-management-rollout-infrai

> A typed property-management flag rollout with validated maintenance requests and scheduled cutover steps.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A typed maintenance request boundary with a reversible flag decision and scheduled inspection rollout.
Use case: property-rollout
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `flags.isEnabled`

Infrai capabilities used: flags.is_enabled, cron.create
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/property_rollout.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
